artworks.title: Peasant Whipping his Donkey
artworks.description: The image shows a man leading a donkey from left to right across the scene. The horizon is low, with subtle land undulations. Some distant structures are visible to the left. The style features fine line work with detailed textures like clothing folds and tree bark. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of black on brownish paper. The man is seen with a cane and hat, guiding the loaded donkey. A barren tree on the right adds a dynamic touch.

artworks.title: Gardener Pruning a Tree
artworks.description: The image displays a rural setting with a man caring for a bare tree in the foreground. The horizon is positioned high, showcasing simple line structures depicting buildings and fields in the distance. The artwork features fine line work, giving a sense of clarity and simplicity. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of black and off-white emphasizing the intricate details. More trees and structures can be seen beyond the man and tree, suggesting depth and continuity in the scene.

artworks.title: The Reeds and the Wind
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a small island covered in tall blades of grass. The horizon is positioned in the middle, dividing the water below from the sky above. The artwork features stylized brushstrokes depicting the grass and water. In the upper left corner, swirling clouds are visible, with a figure sitting on a cloud. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of black and gray against a light background.

artworks.title: Title Page for "The Martyrdoms of the Apostles"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene depicting a crucifixion. The image features a central figure on a cross, surrounded by a gathering of figures who appear reverent and solemn. Above the central figure, ethereal beings are present among billowing clouds. Below the cross is a tomb-like structure with inscriptions. The figures around the tomb carry symbols like spears and religious implements. Beneath the drawing, there is written text.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Peter
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving a figure being hoisted for crucifixion. A group of people gather on a hill, with a radiant figure in the sky above. Soldiers and figures with spears and horses are seen below. Architectural elements like a dome and structures are visible in the background. The drawing is detailed with dynamic lines and shading, capturing movement and drama in the composition.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Paul
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene where a central figure is kneeling on an elevated platform with another figure standing, holding a sword above their head. Surrounding them are numerous figures in various poses, some gesturing, others in conversation. Above the scene, clouds part to reveal a divine figure surrounded by rays of light and smaller winged figures. The lower portion of the image features the inscription "M. B.Pauli Appos. Israel ex". The drawing uses intricate linework and shading in a narrative engraving style.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Andrew
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene with a central figure on a large wooden structure, surrounded by soldiers and onlookers. The composition includes intricate line work detailing the setting, figures, and a figure in the heavens holding two crossed objects. The scene conveys movement and tension through various poses and actions of the figures.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint James Major
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious or historical scene. The central figure is elevated in the sky with rays of light emanating outward. Below, a crowd of figures is gathered around structures reminiscent of classical architecture. The scene is detailed, with columns, arches, and a domed building in the background. The composition is framed by archways and pillars, focusing on the central divine figure. The figures are dressed in robes and classical attire.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a central figure ascending surrounded by clouds. The onlookers are dressed in historical attire. The setting includes architectural structures with domes and arches. Below, a group is engaged in various activities with staffs or spears. The style is fine lines and shading typical of classical etching techniques.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Thomas
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a scene set in an architectural environment. The illustration includes classical architecture and figures in dynamic poses. The setting consists of grand columns and arches that give the impression of a regal or ceremonial hall. Above the central arch, a figure is shown seemingly supported by clouds. Below, there are numerous figures, some holding spears and others in flowing robes, suggesting a potential theatrical or historical theme, possibly from ancient or mythological origins. The lines and detailing in the drawing convey movement and drama throughout the composition.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint James Minor
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical architectural scene with a divine figure amidst clouds above. The drawing depicts a grand architectural space featuring columns and archways. Figures in robes and soldiers holding spears are present in the scene. At the top, a divine figure surrounded by clouds and rays of light is prominently displayed. In the foreground, a small dog and a group of people with distinctive poses further animate the setting. The overall style of this drawing creates an atmosphere reminiscent of classical narratives depicted in religious or historical contexts.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Philip
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a depiction of a crucifixion scene in an architectural setting. The central figure is on a cross, elevated above a crowd, with two figures on ladders near the cross. The background contains architectural elements, including what seems to be a castle or city wall. An ethereal figure on a cloud is above, and the ground shows scattered items. Various dynamic figures surround the cross, some on horseback and some on foot. The style of hatching and cross-hatching adds depth and texture to the composition, portraying a moment of tension and drama.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Bartholomew
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a scene with robed figures in front of a building, with onlookers and architectural details. The figures are gathered around a large structure that resembles a city gate or castle entrance. Some figures are on stairs in the foreground, while above them, beams of light illuminate a figure on a frame or ladder-like structure. Other figures around them are in various poses. In the sky, a figure holding a knife descends amid a burst of light. The composition focuses on the interaction between the grounded figures and the celestial event above, depicted with intricate line work.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Simon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an artist painting on a scaffold in a classical setting. The scene showcases a figure atop a raised platform, working on a large canvas with a grand architectural structure as a backdrop. The setting features an amphitheater-like space with detailed columns and statues. In the sky above, an ethereal figure is shown seated on a cloud. Among the audience, various individuals are seated, watching the creation of art. The intricate line work captures the details of the figures and architecture, conveying a sense of depth and perspective.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Matthias
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene inside an ornate building. The drawing shows grand architectural elements like columns and a domed ceiling with intricate designs. There is an altar with a crucifix at the center. Above, a figure appears to be rising with arms outspread. Below, several figures are shown pointing or looking towards the central altar. The detailed line work and hatching create texture and depth in the composition.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Thaddeus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with architectural elements and dynamic action. The image contains grand architectural structures with large, arched designs. In the center, there is a vertical column or monument. A group of figures is engaged in active motion around it. At the top center, a figure on a cloud emits light. Below, there is a chaotic scene with multiple figures involved in a confrontation, some holding staffs or spears. Various decorative elements and poses contribute to the dramatic narrative.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Matthew
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with classical buildings. The drawing shows elaborate classical buildings with arched windows and doorways. Numerous figures are gathered in a large hall, engaged in various activities. Above the scene, a divine figure is portrayed seated on clouds, illuminated with radiant light. The composition is richly detailed, emphasizing the grandeur and intricate design of the buildings and the dynamic interaction among the figures. The style of the etching is reminiscent of works by early modern European artists who used linear perspectives and detailed engravings to convey narrative and architectural sophistication.

artworks.title: The Death of Judas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene showing a hanging figure. The artwork features a group of robed figures surrounding the hanging figure, with a building in the background and winged figures above. A large tree is depicted in the foreground. The drawing is done in a detailed, finely lined illustration style.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Barnabas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure rising towards the sky, surrounded by a crowd below. The central figure is enveloped by light and clouds. Below, several robed figures stand in a classical architectural setting with columns. In the foreground, individuals are in dynamic poses, some appearing distressed. The scene conveys a sense of divine intervention, using crosshatching for depth and texture. The composition suggests a moment of apotheosis or ascension.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures in a crowded historical or mythological setting within an oval frame. A figure with a radiant aura is at the center of the scene, drawing the attention of others. The composition includes numerous onlookers, some seated and others standing on architectural platforms. Architectural elements like columns and a domed building are in the background. Overhead, clouds and a celestial figure are also depicted. The composition is detailed and dynamic, with a sense of movement and narrative quality.

artworks.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.description: The image shows a city scene with detailed architectural setting and a high horizon. The cityscape includes a hill or small mountain in the distance. The artwork features intricate line work creating texture and depth, especially in the architecture and people. The color palette is mainly sepia or dark brown, giving an aged appearance. The scene includes numerous moving figures and buildings lining a narrowing street. An oval border surrounds the scene.

artworks.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.8 × 10.2 cm (5 7/16 × 4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a bustling scene of a street with grand architectural structures. The buildings feature classical elements like columns and arches. The horizon is positioned higher in the image, framed by buildings on both sides, and hills and buildings are visible in the distance. The artwork shows detailed linework suggesting textures and forms with an engraving technique. The color scheme is monochromatic in brown and black hues, enhancing the historical and intricate feel. There is lively activity with people and horses in motion in the foreground, leading the eye towards calmer areas further into the cityscape.

artworks.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.description: The image depicts an elevated view of a street lined with buildings on both sides. Towards the top of the image, a cloud of smoke or dust rises on the horizon. The etching work is detailed with precise lines characteristic of Jacques Callot's style. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown and sepia tones. In the foreground, a crowd of figures fills the street, engaged in a tumultuous event that extends into the distance, framed by architecture on both sides.

artworks.title: Coins [plate 1]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.7 × 29.7 cm (8 9/16 × 11 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a collection of coin-like designs featuring various emblems and heraldic symbols arranged in a grid pattern. The medallions display intricate engravings of symbols such as crowns, shields, double-headed eagles, and human figures, often accompanied by inscriptions in Latin. Each pair of medallions is connected by an ornate design. The detailing within each medallion showcases textures and patterns rendered with skill, indicative of a meticulous engraving style. The overall layout and detailing suggest a study and representation of noble or royal insignia.
